# agg_advisors_alltime

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.agg_advisors_alltime` · dbt area: `marketplace`

Advisor-level metrics summaries across multiple time windows such as lifetime, first 28/30/60/365 days, and trailing 365 days. Includes bookings (including canceled), sentiment, and other logic around hitting specific thresholds, such as CLIA eligibility for Cruise. Default metrics include canceled bookings; non-canceled versions are available with a 'non_canceled_' prefix. Each row represents metrics for a single advisor. Booking dates are based on the Booking's created date. Sourced from the Portal database.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `advisor_id` | The 'User ID' in the Portal database  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `clia_eligible_date` | Date when a Certified or above Advisor surpassed $10,000 in commissionable booking value for Cruise bookings, making them eligible to become a CLIA (Cruise Lines International Association) member. >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `commissionable_booking_value_usd_alltime_booked` | The sum of Commissionable Booking Value for all Bookings (including canceled), over all time, in USD. Calculated using the Booking's created date.  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
